scientific_intent.application_domain: Domain-neutral distributed vector reduction and scientific-workflow collective aggregation
scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Two-rank pointwise Float32 sum implemented by actual NCCL ncclAllReduce; MPI host bootstrap
scientific_intent.community_use: Reusable communication component for distributed numerical workflows; no particular simulation, training convergence or multinode application validated.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact complete two-rank dyadic sums, actual device input/initial receive/read-only readbacks and guards; independent Float64 sum from saved actual inputs.
limitations: Two same-host V100 devices5,6 and NCCL2.18.5 only; no single-device aggregate.
Primary up-to10M counts and50 repeats; original100M/1B R1 diagnostic is separate, not accepted full capture or performance.
Vendor collective has zero authored source device kernels; KA/JACC allocation and host orchestration do not establish portable collectives.
Default-pool KA stalled and pool-none diagnostic passed; specific allocator failure cause not proved.
Guard offset changes buffer alignment equally across four versions.
